title: Introduction to Spring Security
description: Understand why security matters and the core concepts of authentication and authorization.

slides.title: Why Security Matters 🛡️
slides.content:
# Every Application Needs Protection

Without security, your APIs are open to anyone. Malicious users could:
- Access sensitive data.
- Perform actions they shouldn't (e.g., delete data).
- Exploit vulnerabilities.

Spring Security provides a comprehensive, customizable security framework for your applications.

quizData.question: What are the two main concepts in Spring Security?
quizData.explanation: Authentication verifies who you are; authorization determines what you can do.

slides.title: Authentication vs. Authorization 🔐
slides.content:
# Know the Difference

| Concept | Meaning | Example |
|---------|---------|---------|
| **Authentication** | Who are you? | Entering username/password. |
| **Authorization** | What can you do? | A user with role `ADMIN` can delete users, while a `USER` can only view. |

Spring Security handles both, often using **roles** and **permissions**.

slides.title: Spring Security is Modular 🔧
slides.content: You can plug in different authentication mechanisms: form login, Basic Auth, OAuth2, LDAP, JWT, etc. The core remains the same.
